egress.terms: Free and unranged-open. Article attachments are served from `support.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/<id>` with no auth, no referer check, `Accept-Ranges: bytes`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` permissive, `x-amz-replication-status: COMPLETED`, AES256 at rest.

tooling: Help Center API (`/api/v2/help_center/articles/{id}/attachments.json` returns the public `content_url`). Third-party CLI `tukaelu/zgsync` adds a Guide media subcommand.
chaining: 20 MB per file x unbounded attachments per article, but the 10 GB account file-storage pool is the wall. Trial-only for a free account, so the multiplier is trial instances, which is a bad trade.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 20 MB per file/image in articles (2 MB for community images). Quota: account file storage 10 GB base + 2 GB/agent. request-rate: Guide API is rate limited; an unauthenticated write probe `POST /api/v2/help_center/articles.json` returned 403 (good — no open write). Retention: archived tickets still count toward storage.
